"### Investigation Summary: Organization 142 Workspace Suspension

#### Root Cause
Organization 142's workspace remains suspended because a **duplicate unpaid invoice (Invoice #90018)** was generated for the exact same billing period (`2026-09-04`) as Invoice #90017. 

When Invoice #90017 was paid on `2026-09-29`, the reactivation handler (`onInvoicePaid` in `src/billing.ts`) evaluated whether the organization was still delinquent via `isDelinquent(142)`. Because duplicate invoice #90018 was still in `open` status with a due date of `2026-09-11` (> 14 days past due), `isDelinquent(142)` returned `true`. Consequently, the reactivation query was bypassed, leaving Organization 142 in `suspended` status and its subscription in `past_due` status.
